name: Aurora
title: The Witch Between Worlds

passive.name: Spirit Abjuration

description.normalized: Damaging an enemy 3 times with abilities or attacks exorcises them, dealing 2.5% (+2%AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage. If the enemy is a champion, it also frees a spirit that follows Aurora for 4 seconds, restoring her Health by 1 - 18 (+2% AP) every second ( max 4 spirits) .

passive.rawParsedText:
Damaging an enemy 3 times with abilities or attacks exorcises them, dealing 2.5% (+2%AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage.

If the enemy is a champion, it also frees a spirit that follows Aurora for 4 seconds, restoring her Health by 1 - 18 (+2% AP) every second ( max 4 spirits) .

q.name: Twofold Hex

description.normalized: First Cast: Fires cursed energy ion a direction, dealing 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+33% AP) magic damage to enemies and cursing them for 3.5 seconds. Recast: Detonates the curse, dealing up to 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+33% AP) magic damage to enemies passed through. Enemies take up to 50% bonus damage based on missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced by 20%. Deals 40% damage against minions and monsters instead. If the curse's duration runs out, Aurora will automatically recast the ability.

w.name: Across the Veil

description.normalized: Hops in a direction. Upon landing, enters the spirit realm, becoming invisible for 1 / 1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 seconds and entering Realm Hopper. Real Hopper: Gains 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this ability's cooldown.

e.name: The Weirding

description.normalized: Converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that deals 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+65% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slows them by 80%, decaying over 1 second. Aurora hops backward a short distance after casting.

e.rawParsedText:

Aurora hops backward a short distance after casting.

r.name: Between Worlds

description.normalized: First Cast: Leaps in a direction. Upon landing, converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals 150 / 250 / 350 (+50% AP) magic damage and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. The area of convergence stays active for 2.5 / 3.25 / 4 seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper and allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another. Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are slowed by 50% for 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds. Recast: Ends the area of convergence effect early.
